content.value_statement: Pinia apps often fail from early store access, broken reactivity, or hidden setup-store state. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical checks for safer Vue state management.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to avoid the no active Pinia startup error.
Shows when to return all state from Pinia setup stores.
Compares storeToRefs destructuring with direct store access.
Guides URL state patterns for shareable filters.
Covers template method binding gotchas and parentheses.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not run project tests.
It focuses on Vue 3 and Pinia, not Vuex migration details.
It cannot verify SSR behavior without project-specific context.
It does not replace official Pinia documentation for API coverage.

use_cases.title: Fix Store Initialization Errors
use_cases.description: Diagnose startup crashes caused by calling Pinia stores before the app installs Pinia.

use_cases.title: Review Setup Store Design
use_cases.description: Check whether setup stores return required state for DevTools, SSR, plugins, and persistence.

use_cases.title: Plan Shareable Filter State
use_cases.description: Choose when filters belong in the URL, a Pinia store, or a hybrid pattern.

prompt_templates.title: Fix a Startup Error
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my Vue app startup flow for the no active Pinia error. Identify store calls that run too early and suggest the correct order.

prompt_templates.title: Review Store Reactivity
prompt_templates.prompt: Check this component for Pinia destructuring problems. Explain which values should use storeToRefs and which actions should stay on the store.

prompt_templates.title: Plan URL Filter State
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me design filter state for a product list. Decide which values should live in the URL and which should stay in Pinia.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Large Pinia App
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this Pinia architecture for setup-store return issues, SSR risks, plugin order problems, and method binding mistakes. Prioritize production risks.

output_examples.input: A Vue app crashes during startup with the no active Pinia message.
output_examples.output: The review identifies a store call that runs before Pinia installation. It recommends installing Pinia before router guards and moving store access inside runtime functions.

output_examples.input: A setup store keeps auth state private by not returning it.
output_examples.output: The review explains the SSR, DevTools, and plugin risks. It recommends returning every reactive state value and using naming conventions for internal fields.

output_examples.input: A product page loses filter selections after refresh.
output_examples.output: The guidance separates shareable filters from private UI state. It recommends URL-backed values for search and categories, with Pinia for complex local state.

best_practices: Install Pinia before plugins that access stores.
Return all reactive state, computed getters, and actions from setup stores.
Use storeToRefs for reactive state destructuring and keep actions on the store.
anti_patterns: Calling useStore at module scope before app initialization.
Hiding setup-store state by omitting it from the return value.
Passing store methods as bare template references when context matters.

faq.question: What Pinia problems does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers startup timing, setup-store state, reactivity during destructuring, URL filter state, and template method binding.

faq.question: Can it update my project automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide Claude, Codex, or Claude Code during edits, but the skill itself contains reference guidance only.

faq.question: Does it cover server-side rendering?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains why setup stores must return state for SSR serialization and hydration.

faq.question: Is this only for new Vue projects?
faq.answer: No. It is useful for existing Vue 3 projects that already use Pinia or plan to adopt it.

faq.question: Does it replace Pinia documentation?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on common implementation mistakes and should be used with official API documentation.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The skill declares support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
